notes: SR6 Restoration Hardware / rh.com. ACCESS: rh.com is behind DataDome on every path (confirmed on plain curl, curl_cffi with chrome124 impersonation, and headless Playwright - all three returned the DataDome 'Verify you're human' CAPTCHA/403 even on /robots.txt), matching the prior Home-Decor pass's note that headless render is CAPTCHA-walled. Per tier order this is a genuine anti-bot wall defeating tiers 1 and 2, so tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, a real logged-in browser session) was used. robots.txt (read successfully via Claude-in-Chrome) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry at all - no Claude-specific disallow, so browsing is permitted. ABSENCE CHECK FOR PET CARE: read the full RH HTML site map at https://rh.com/us/en/sitemap (client-rendered, all sections expanded) covering every top nav branch - Estates, Living, Dining, Bed, Bath, Outdoor, Lighting, Textiles, Rugs, Decor (Mirrors/Wall Art/Wall Decor/Decorative Accents/Cabinet Hardware/Bar/Drapery/Pillows/Throws), and the full Sale rollups of each - zero occurrences of Pet/Dog/Cat as a category or sub-category anywhere in that tree. Also checked BABY & CHILD and TEEN nav items: TEEN resolves to https://rhteen.rh.com (a separate RH sister-brand subdomain/site, out of scope for this rh.com/Restoration Hardware assignment); Baby & Child is the equivalent separate sister-brand site and was not crawled for the same reason. Also cross-checked https://rh.com/first-level-category-sitemap.xml (4460 category URLs) - this file only contains bare categoryId URLs with no names, so it could not be keyword-searched, but it corroborates no incremental category families exist beyond the named tree above (same total category count order-of-magnitude as the prior Home-Decor pass's cross-check). Ran RH's own site search for 'dog bed' (https://rh.com/us/en/search/results.jsp?Ntt=dog+bed) as an extra check - it returned 4503 results consisting of bedside tables, panel beds, etc. (i.e. it appears to return the full/default sale catalog regardless of query, a non-discriminating search per the known false-absence-test site pattern), so this result was NOT used as evidence of absence or presence, only the navigation/sitemap tree was relied on. CONCLUSION: Restoration Hardware (rh.com) does not sell pet care products under any dedicated or contextual category - no Pet Care rows to report. This is a legitimate zero, not a block.
